title: Share of children who out-earn their parents, by birth cohort
cap: Absolute income mobility: share of children whose pre-tax family income at about age 30 exceeded their parents' at the same age, CPI-U-RS, 2014 dollars (Chetty et al., Science 2017). Only the cohorts stated numerically in the paper and slides are shown; intermediate cohorts are in Opportunity Insights online Table 1.
